data.value: Move the latency until each beep plays as the light flashes and the note reaches the line. The first beat of each bar beeps higher, lights in another colour and has a wider note.

data.value: The arrow keys move it by 1 ms, or by 5 ms with Shift. A change is heard from the next beep.
